spec.description:
Kingspan Universal
Insulation Retaining Clips (Insu-loc discs) are 80mm diameter polypropylene
retaining discs engineered to hold rigid insulation boards (such as Kooltherm K8
Cavity Board) firmly against the inner leaf of masonry cavity walls. Designed
with a universal grip center, they fit securely over standard wall ties
including butterfly, double triangle, and vertical twist profiles without
slipping. By clamping the insulation board flush against the inner wall, they
prevent board dislodgement, eliminate cavity bridging, and maintain the required
clear drainage airspace.
features:
80mm diameter circular disc provides
broad clamping area across insulation boards

Universal central gripping teeth
fit butterfly, double triangle, and vertical twist wall ties

Firm grip design prevents
clips from moving, vibrating, or sliding along the wall tie

Ensures rigid
boards remain flush against the inner masonry leaf without slumping

Maintains
a clear, unobstructed residual drainage cavity in masonry walls

Prevents
mortar droppings from pushing boards into the cavity

Supplied in trade packs
of 250 pieces for convenient jobsite handling

technical.value: Butterfly, double triangle, vertical twist, and wire wall ties

Rigid
boards (Kooltherm K8, PIR, XPS) and semi-rigid mineral wool slabs

spec.fire:
Non-contributing polymer accessory; compliant for use within masonry cavity
fire walls
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 2699.1 (Wall ties for masonry construction),
BS EN ISO 9001, NCC Volume One and Two
install:
Bed wall ties into inner
masonry leaf mortar joints at specified vertical and horizontal intervals

Push Kooltherm K8 Cavity Board over the wall ties and position flat against the
inner leaf

Slide Universal Insulation Retaining Clip over the protruding end
of each wall tie

Push clip firmly along the tie until it presses tightly
against the outer face of the insulation board

Ensure clip locks onto tie
notches, holding the board flat and immovable

Maintain a minimum of 2 to 3
retaining clips per 1200x450mm board (at least one clip per tie)

Verify the
residual drainage cavity between the board and outer brick leaf remains
completely clear
selection_checklist:
Confirm wall tie type and
diameter are compatible with universal clip teeth

Calculate required quantity
based on number of wall ties (minimum 250 per pack)

Verify insulation is
rigid board (e.g. Kooltherm K8) or semi-rigid slab in a cavity wall

Check
requirement for 80mm broad load-distribution disc
limitations:
Designed for cavity wall ties; not suitable for direct masonry screw or nail
fixing

Must not be forced onto oversized ties exceeding clip aperture to
prevent cracking

Non-structural accessory; does not carry structural wall
loads
spec.warranty: Covered under Kingspan wall system warranty

retrieval.rag_summary:
Kingspan Universal Insulation
Retaining Clips are 80mm diameter polypropylene retaining discs engineered to
hold rigid insulation boards (such as Kooltherm K8) firmly against the inner
leaf of masonry cavity walls. Featuring universal gripping teeth that lock onto
butterfly, double triangle, and vertical-twist wall ties, they prevent boards
from shifting, slumping, or bridging the cavity. By ensuring boards stay flat
against the inner wall, they maintain the critical clear drainage space required
to stop moisture penetration across external brickwork.
